summary: Well-designed test suite with excellent organization and separation of concerns (library tests, workflow tests, act harness), but fundamentally incomplete. Critical gaps: (1) test fixtures referenced in tests (`fixtures/run1.junit.xml`, `fixtures/run3.json`, `testcases/case-b/*`) are not provided; tests cannot run without them; (2) no CLI-level tests for Invoke-Aggregator.ps1 parameters (-Path, -OutFile, -Quiet) or script-level error handling (exit code 2); (3) missing edge cases: zero-failure scenarios, diverse status spellings (only 'failed'/'passed'/'skipped' tested, not 'errored'/'notrun'/'success'), encoding issues, special characters in names; (4) brittle exact-string matching in act output assertions (e.g., `'[SUMMARY] passed=12 failed=3...'`) will break on minor formatting changes. Strengths: clear test naming, good use of Pester, end-to-end act testing, proper temp cleanup, logical describe blocks. The tests show solid design intent but cannot execute due to missing fixtures, violating the core requirement 'All tests must be runnable with Invoke-Pester'.
